per_cell.k_star: the cycle the settling rule v2 certified (None when uncertified at its cap)
per_cell.band: [min, max] Q over the certifying window (uncertified: over the last L = 60 cycles)
per_cell.range_over_tau: range of the certifying window / tau
per_cell.s: gated cells: s = Q_k* - Q_N_old (Q_N_old = the ORIGINAL record's last cycle; resolution band_width)
per_cell.t_sum_k_star: t_sum at k* (in-cycle, validated post-run against the stride and the terminal identity)
per_cell.overlap: gated cells, REPORT-ONLY: Q_new(k) - Q_old(k) for k0+1..N_old; relative = (Q_new - Q_old) / Q_old; at N_old scored against the recorded prediction
per_cell.terminal_step_to_threshold: |dQ_last| / EPS0 and, for certified cells, range / tau at k*; production's rule ten (objective_change_abs / objective_tolerance) of the last row

definitions.uncertified_form: frozen (settling_criterion_v2): band [min, max] over the last L = 60 cycles; drift rate = mean dQ over the last 25 cycles; dQ_cc rate = mean (dQ + dt_sum) over the same cycles; t_sum and Q_cc at the cap; reasons (including gap_clause); an uncertified cell's differences are INDETERMINATE by construction

differences.phase_b_and_year_ladder_vs_settled_x0: M_j = I_j + Q_j(k*) - Q181, Q181 = 653,873,702.1876609 (settled x = 0, W102 cycle 181); resolution_j = band_j + band_x0 (band_x0 = 4,209.1713362932205); determinate iff |M_j| > resolution_j. Q_cc: M_j^cc = I_j + Q_j(k*) + t_j(k*) - (Q181 + t_x0), t_x0 = 142.52829384803772. I_j from the cited source (Phase B: phase_b_state.json I_x_eur; year ladder: W2 investment_cost_results.json I_new_eur)
differences.f2_certificate: D = (I_c - I_i) + (Q_c(k*_c) - Q_i(k*_i)); resolution band_c + band_i; D_cc = D + (t_c(k*_c) - t_i(k*_i)). If either cell is uncertified D is INDETERMINATE by construction; the bands and rates are reported. Expert's note (Addendum 57 Decision 3(c)): the cited 6,338 EUR margin is < 2 tau, so "within resolution" is the expected verdict and it is acceptable
differences.year_ladder_2035_minus_2030: D_yl = (I_2035 + Q_2035(k*)) - (I_2030 + Q_2030(k*)); resolution band_2030 + band_2035; D_yl^cc = D_yl + (t_2035 - t_2030); plus each year against x = 0 (M_j above)
differences.verdict_words: determinate (|x| > resolution) | within resolution (|x| <= resolution) | indeterminate_uncertified

gate_outcome.statement: every gated cell replays BITWISE through k0 (the in-cycle gate never aborts; G19 holds)

phase_b.statement: oscillatory certification at k* in [k0 + 50, k0 + 70]; s_j in [+8, +30] kEUR; |s_j - 14,971| <= 10 kEUR; margins stay positive (M_j > 0: x = 0 stays better); |t_sum(k*)| < tau/2
phase_b.source: Planner task W118 (attribution not stated in the task; searched: brief Addenda 53-57, the consolidated note, TASKS.md, REVISION_CONTEXT.md -- recorded as given)
